name: droidline
description: Let an AI agent see and use a real Android phone over Wi-Fi, without ADB or root.
long_description: Every Droidline command is a tool: read the screen, find elements by text or ID, tap, type, swipe, take screenshots, run OCR, open apps and settings, and read notifications. The phone runs the Droidline app (Android 9 or later) and pairs once with `droidline pair`. If no `droidline serve` is running, the tool starts one inside itself.
